title: Project Play
tagline: A little help. A whole lot of play.
description: Help us build a new place to play.
story: Our playground structure has reached the end of its service life, and our school community is coming together to help replace it. Through Project Play, we’re raising funds to support a safe, engaging play space for current and future Mineola students.
seoDescription: Help the Mineola school community create a new place to play. Follow campaign news and ways to support Project Play.
